answer: Before an agent may list a property, the municipal building department binds the permit number to one parcel, one licensed contractor of record and one signed inspection card, and a certificate of occupancy issues only when all three match. Reusing a permit on a second parcel trips a stop-work order, voids the permit and refers the contractor to the state license board. A permit at 450 dollars, plan review at 180 and inspections at 120 put each fake at 750 plus a licensed human, so N clones burn N x 750 and N licenses. A sable door and a mirror in the hollow lobby change nothing.
